text:
Sam Cheng: Vendor flagged a partial DOA on FRA top-off: 6x H100s. They proposed rebooking via air with surcharge. AWB CVG1234567890.
Maria Ortiz: Which allocation?
Sam Cheng: alloc-2026-fra-07.
Jeff Patel: What's the earliest flight? Customs look?
Sam Cheng: Earliest flight 03/28; customs could add 24-48h. Expedited surcharge quoted 1,450/unit.
Anya Kowalski: That kills our Dedicated pool cost. Can we mix shipping and loaners?
Maria Ortiz: We have 4 loaners in AMS available up to 72h. Proposal: air 2 urgent, loaners 4, vendor ships rest by sea if needed.
RMA Ops: Need depot photos + failure codes before we switch AWB. Upload to RMA tracker: https://rma.internal/track/alloc-2026-fra-07
procurement-bot: Note: monthly cap on expedited surcharges = $12k. Current spend = $9.2k.
Jeff Patel: Two air units at 1,450 = 2,900 (~$3.15k). Within remaining budget.
Anya Kowalski: Do loaners need reprovisioning? Time?
Sam Cheng: Loaners on 1.6.2, target 1.6.4. Reimage ~40m/node; parallelized all 4 in ~90m.
Maria Ortiz: FRA customs flagged refurbished imports last week. Vendor must declare "replacement under warranty" to avoid holds.
RMA Ops: Confirm. Vendor must provide commercial invoice with that phrasing + depot photos + serials before dispatch or customs delay 3-5d.
procurement-bot: Reminder: finance approval required for single shipments > $10k surcharge. Proposed expedite ~ $3.15k, so no finance sign-off needed.
Jeff Patel: Vendor also mentions coordination fee for AWB split. How much?
Sam Cheng: Coordination fee 600 one-time. If we accept loaners they offered to waive it.
Anya Kowalski: I'll accept if loaners can be online quickly. Need canary plan for latency-sensitive EU customers.
Maria Ortiz: Ops plan: reimage 4 loaners -> 1.6.4, canary 10% then 50% after verification. SLOs preserved.
RMA Ops: Holding RMA approval until vendor photos + serial list and customs phrasing received. I'll post the template for vendor.
Sam Cheng: Pinged vendor, copying @maria for contract.
Maria Ortiz: If vendor refuses warranty declaration, ask them to cover customs/detention fees per CL-EX-9.
procurement-bot: Contract clause CL-EX-9 cited: vendor responsible for mis-declared duties.
Jeff Patel: TL;DR path: air 2, loaners 4, vendor provides RMA evidence + mark warranty replacement, coordination fee waived. Need Maria to greenlight.
Maria Ortiz: OK proceed. Sam: tell vendor 2 air, RMA evidence within 4h, mark as warranty replacement, vendor covers customs if mis-declared. Proceed with AWB CVG1234567890 once confirmed.
Sam Cheng: Vendor replied: photos uploaded, serials attached, will mark as warranty replacement. Uploading now.
RMA Ops: Verified photos & serials in tracker. Creating RMA-8742. Depot pickup window booked 03/26 07:00-11:00 CET.
Sam Cheng: Vendor confirmed AWB split and waived coordination fee if we accept loaners.
Maria Ortiz: Final decision: 2 air, 4 loaners, vendor marks warranty replacement, coordination fee waived.
Anya Kowalski: Canary and rollback runbook ready. Snippet:
```
# quick rollback
1. Shift canary back to baseline: /routes/canary -> v0.92
2. Drain loaner nodes: kubectl cordon && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets 
3. Reattach replaced nodes once verified
```
Jeff Patel: Thanks team, keep updates here short. :thumbsup:
Sam Cheng: Closing but will reopen on customs hiccups.
